Personal pronouns and possessives · 要点精讲: Distinguish the three forms of pronouns: I/me/my, they/them/their; choose by the part of speech in the sentence.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Subject pronouns act as subjects, object pronouns as objects, adjectival possessives modify nouns。

Subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they act as subjects|Object pronouns: me, you, him, her, it, us, them act as objects or after prepositions|Adjectival possessive pronouns my/your/his/her/our/their must be followed by a noun|Nominal possessives mine/yours/hers stand alone at the end of a sentence|its means 'something's', different from it's = it is
Can you help me with science?
Can you help I with science?|Can you help my with science?|Can you help mine with science?|Can you help me with science?
column4: Subject pronouns act as subjects, object pronouns as objects, adjectival possessives modify nouns。正确句:Can you help me with science?
